summary: Build a full-stack real estate marketplace (OLX-like) for selling land and newly built homes, with owner listings, image uploads, INR pricing, and buyer contact/offer flows including discounted offer options.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Minimal premium real estate wordmark logo (realty-logo.dim_512x256.png)
- Neutral property placeholder photo/illustration tile with subtle texture (property-placeholder.dim_1200x800.png)
- Empty state illustration for no search results (no-results.dim_900x600.png)

existing_features.title: Add Internet Identity authentication so users can sign in/out and the app can associate actions (creating listings, sending offers/messages) to an authenticated Principal.

Implement a property listing data model and CRUD endpoints for sellers to create and manage listings for land and newly built homes, including title, category/type, description, quoted price in Indian Rupees (INR), location text fields, and timestamps.
Support uploading and displaying multiple images per listing, including selecting multiple files in the UI, uploading them, and rendering them in a gallery/carousel on the listing detail page.

Create buyer browsing experience: a home/feed page with search and filters for listing type (Land/Home) and price range, and a listing detail page with images, description, price in INR, and seller contact/offer actions.
Implement a contact-seller flow where a buyer can send a message to the seller for a specific listing, and the seller can view received contact messages per listing.

Implement an offer flow where, for a listing’s quoted price, the UI generates exactly 3 lower offer options by reducing the quoted price by 35% (applied successively per option) and the buyer can select one option (or choose a custom offer, if included) and submit it to the seller.
Format all prices consistently as Indian Rupees (INR) across the UI, including listing cards, listing detail, and offer options.
Add seller dashboard pages to manage listings and handle inbound messages/offers: “My Listings”, “Inbox (Messages)”, and “Offers”.

Establish a coherent, modern visual theme for the marketplace UI (typography, spacing, colors, components) optimized for a ‘premium real estate’ feel, and apply it consistently across the feed, listing detail, and dashboard screens.
Add generated static brand and placeholder images and wire them into the UI as static assets served from the frontend (not from the backend).

new_feature_requests.summary: User accounts for property owners (sign up/login) to manage listings
Create and publish property listings (land/new built homes) with description and quoted price options in INR
Upload and display multiple images for each property listing
Buyer can contact seller and/or make an offer on a listing
Offer flow includes 3 lower-price options derived by reducing quoted price by 35% (3 options)
